goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.label: Product safety information reaching the company is recognised and reported within the required window, without relying on individual vigilance.
goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.measure: Proportion of inbound PSI-bearing contacts that are reported inside the regulatory window, and the count of late or missed reports found on audit.

reachability.trainable: Recognition. Staff who encounter a contact cannot report what they do not identify as product safety information in the first place — that is a knowledge and discrimination problem, and it is the part instruction can move.
not_trainable: Reporting channel friction — if the intake path is slow or unclear, trained staff still report late. Process, not instruction.
Workload and staffing — recognition under time pressure degrades regardless of how well someone was taught.
Incentive structure — where reporting is perceived to create work or risk for the reporter, training does not overcome it.
reachability.rationale: The two seeded objectives (define PSI, recognise PSI) both sit squarely on the recognition half. Naming the other three causes explicitly keeps a later audit from reading a flat reporting rate as a training failure — which is the failure mode this gate exists to prevent.

goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.derived_from: AST009 reference programme; the outcome implied by atom-spec §4's objectives, made explicit here for the first time.

goal_alsap_asset_safety_monitored.label: Emerging safety risks at the asset level are identified, evaluated, and communicated through a single maintained ALSAP during clinical development.
goal_alsap_asset_safety_monitored.measure: Proportion of in-scope assets with a current ALSAP (annual SMT review complete; ad hoc updates after signals, regulatory changes, or milestones), and the count of assets proceeding in development without one.

reachability.trainable: Knowing what an ALSAP is and that one exists per asset; who is in scope; and how to run the three procedure cycles the SOP names (plan development, develop/maintain/approve, analysis datasets and TLFs including protecting the blind). Those are knowledge and procedure-following problems instruction can move.
not_trainable: EDMS or SCE friction — if filing, routing, or restricted-folder access is slow, a trained ALSAP Lead still misses windows. Process, not instruction.
SMT meeting culture and schedule — alignment and review cycles fail when the forum does not meet, regardless of how well the SOP was taught.
Data quality that triggers ad hoc updates, and the regulatory changes themselves — those are inputs to the plan, not outputs of training.
Workload that compresses the 10-business-day review — training does not create calendar time.
reachability.rationale: SOP-AST-29080 exists to operationalize asset-level safety monitoring. The trainable slice is the procedure the atoms already state. Naming EDMS, SMT cadence, data quality, and workload as not-trainable keeps a later missing-ALSAP count from being read as a training failure.
